role_summary: Strategic leadership role overseeing IT infrastructure, hybrid/multi-cloud operations, and digital transformation. Responsible for aligning IT services with business growth, cybersecurity integration, and leading high-performing technical teams in a fast-paced environment.
must_have_requirements: 15+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, operations, or cloud management
5+ years in a senior leadership role leading IT teams
Proven experience in managing hybrid or multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Ali Cloud)
Degree in Computer Science or related fields
Track record in cloud migration or infrastructure modernization projects
Proficiency in cybersecurity integration within infrastructure operations
nice_to_have_requirements: Experience operating in Mainland China markets
Specific certifications in Cloud (AWS/Azure) or ITIL frameworks

scoring_criteria.name: Senior IT Leadership Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Determines the candidate's ability to manage senior-level stakeholders and high-scale operations.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Less than 5 years in senior leadership

scoring_criteria.name: Hybrid/Multi-Cloud Maturity
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Essential for modernized IT service delivery and infrastructure cost optimization.

scoring_criteria.name: Infrastructure Operations & Reliability
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Ensures the candidate understands business continuity and uptime mandates.

scoring_criteria.name: Business Alignment & Strategy
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The role requires translating business goals into IT roadmaps.

scoring_criteria.name: Cybersecurity Integration
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Ensures security-by-design, a critical requirement of the JD.

scoring_criteria.name: Team Development Expertise
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must be able to foster a collaborative culture and clear career paths.

scoring_criteria.name: Cultural Fit & Change Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Requirement for navigating complex, multifaceted organizations.

scoring_criteria.name: Mainland China Exposure
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Preferred skill set due to geographical scope.

summary_focus: Ability to align technology with corporate revenue goals
do_not_overclaim: Infrastructure management without direct team leadership experience
Sole responsibility for security without collaborative experience

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Emphasize yourself as a bridge between technical operations and business value creation.
bridge_gaps_honestly: Highlight transferable transformation experience if specific legacy systems mentioned are missing
Explain how management style fosters innovation in challenging markets
